description: Source code for a PDF document loader component in a larger software project, implementing the INode interface, with methods for initializing and extracting documents from PDF files, supporting options like text splitting, metadata handling, and legacy PDF parsing.

classes.name: Pdf_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing a PDF document loader node, capable of loading and processing PDF files into document objects with metadata and content.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, loads PDF files from storage or base64, processes metadata, and returns documents or concatenated text.

methods.name: extractDocs
methods.description: Extracts documents from a PDF buffer, supporting perFile or perPage usage, with optional text splitting and legacy PDF parsing.
